rules: Early colonies may rely on external support and real travel time.
Support cargo cannot teleport or exist without transport capacity.
Local self-sufficiency grows only from actual infrastructure/capability.
A broken route matters only when the colony depends on it.
Block 2 tracks support/viability summaries; detailed production, markets and shipping economics belong to Block 4.
Insufficient support may cause stagnation, decline or evacuation but not an uncaused instant disappearance.
